summary: Frontend testing completed for BIONIC micro-zones features on Mon Territoire BIONIC page. All 9 requested features verified working: Mode Micro (circles), Mode Classique (hexagons), Cercles concentriques toggle, Corridors & Tampons toggle, Seuil minimum slider, Mode privé toggle, mode switching, badge counter updates, and page load.

issues: Zone tooltips may be difficult to trigger on overlapping zones due to pointer event interception - this is expected Leaflet behavior for stacked elements

critical_code_review_comments: BionicMicroZones component correctly implements circular zones with Leaflet Circle elements
Zone filtering by minPercentage works correctly - higher threshold = fewer zones displayed
Privacy mode toggle correctly shows/hides waypoints and places with appropriate text feedback
Mode switching between Micro and Classique updates the badge counter correctly
CSS styles for bionic-zone-circle include drop-shadow for visual depth
context_for_next_testing_agent: BIONIC micro-zones features are fully functional. The AFFICHAGE ZONES panel in the left sidebar contains: Micro/Classique mode buttons, Cercles concentriques toggle, Corridors & Tampons toggle, Seuil min. slider (30-80%), and Mode privé toggle. The ZONES badge in top-right shows count and current mode.

mode_micro_circles.notes: Circular zones render with thin outlines, terrain visible through transparency. Badge shows 'ZONES 50 Micro'

mode_classique_hexagons.notes: Hexagonal zones render with colored fills. Badge shows 'ZONES 100 Classique'

cercles_concentriques_toggle.notes: Toggle switches between checked/unchecked states correctly

corridors_tampons_toggle.notes: Toggle switches between checked/unchecked states correctly

seuil_minimum_slider.notes: Slider range 30-80%. At 50%: 50 zones, at 70%: 43 zones, at 80%: 34 zones - filtering works correctly

mode_prive_toggle.notes: Toggle works. When ON: shows 'Données personnelles masquées'. When OFF: shows 'Waypoints et lieux visibles'

mode_switching.notes: Clicking Micro/Classique buttons switches display mode and updates badge

badge_counter_update.notes: Badge shows zone count and mode indicator (e.g., '50 Micro' or '100 Classique')

page_load.notes: Mon Territoire BIONIC page loads correctly with map, zones, and all controls visible
